The seemingly unstoppable bug hordes have reached the center of Federatsiyagrad, the capital city of Kwalasha.

The Mobile Infantry headquarters within the city has been completely cut off, but Terran Command has assured the arrival of a new weapon will soon turn the tide of the war.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/OBJECTIVE: CLEAR BUG LAIRS/TRIGGERS/SPEECH: LOAN FROM RICO ==============

column2: Take good care of those Marauders. They’re on loan from General Rico.
Aw, we have to give them back?
The reinforcements have arrived to get you out of the city
That’s a beautiful sight.
Marauder team, clean up the bugs, take out the bug lairs.
Let’s see what you can do!
Push forward into the city center.
No slacking off! Just because the Marauders are here, doesn’t mean everyone else can take it easy.
Those things are powerful, but they're not invulnerable. We've got to look after the Marauders.
The defenders can't hold much longer.
Bugs are inside the compound! They're done for.
Package is down. We've failed to extract the officer!
The compound can't hold for much longer. I reckon we've got 5 minutes before the Bug's break in.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/OBJECTIVE: EVACUATE COMMANDER/TRIGGERS/DETOUR INFORMATION/BRIEFING: DON'T GO THROUGH COMPOUND ==============

column2: That compound won’t hold. Evacuate across the bridge, while you still can.
But the Sky Marshal said “Not one step back.”
We don’t always need to take those speeches literally...
The officer has reached safety. Let us hope the others' sacrifice was worth it.
The compound is going to fall.
We need that officer extracted to safety on the other side of the bridge.
What about the other defenders?
They will buy you time.
Understood. We'll have to go around the compound to avoid running into Bug assaults. The only available route looks to be through the purification plant to the south-east.
Good work. Those Marauders are worth their weight in gold.
Bugs have infiltrated across the river. We're going to need to clear this bank if we're going to preserve the civilian workforce
Roger that. We'll take out those hives before they can spread.
Inform Command that we're looking at a total loss.
Package is down. We've failed to extract the officer!
More MI holding out! Let's get them out of trouble.
Ambush! They were waiting for us!
A smart strategy, for bugs. These warriors are being directly controlled by a ruling caste insect.
You mean a brain bug. There’s one on Kwalasha?
If there wasn’t, we would have won already.
The Arachnids have the city entrance blockaded.
Not for long. We’ll travel up the highway, kill anything that crawls.
There's a crap load of Bugs coming down the road!
Another Marauder has arrived. Give those bugs hell, captain.
Where have these been all my life?
Classified. Until now.
